description: Na₃NbOF₆ crystallizes in the orthorhombic P2_12_12₁ space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to one O and six F atoms to form distorted NaOF₆ pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with five equivalent NbOF₆ pentagonal bipyramids and  an edgeedge with one NbOF₆ pentagonal bipyramid. The Na-O bond length is 2.39 Å. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.69 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to one O and six F atoms. The Na-O bond length is 2.70 Å. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.54 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to one O and six F atoms. The Na-O bond length is 2.60 Å. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.63 Å. Nb is bonded to one O and six F atoms to form NbOF₆ pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with five equivalent NaOF₆ pentagonal bipyramids and  an edgeedge with one NaOF₆ pentagonal bipyramid. The Nb-O bond length is 1.78 Å. There are a spread of Nb-F bond distances ranging from 2.06-2.14 Å. O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Nb atom. There are six inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded to three Na and one Nb atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing FNa₃Nb tetrahedra. In the second F site, F is bonded to three Na and one Nb atom to form distorted corner-sharing FNa₃Nb tetrahedra. In the third F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Nb atom. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one Nb atom. In the fifth F site, F is bonded to three Na and one Nb atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing FNa₃Nb tetrahedra. In the sixth F site, F is bonded to three Na and one Nb atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing FNa₃Nb tetrahedra.
